title: Libra: what to know
description: The essentials of Libra in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Libra: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Sep 23 - Oct 22. Air element, cardinal quality, ruled by Venus.

pages.title: Balance
pages.text: Libra sees both sides, seeks harmony and is good at mediating conflict.

pages.title: Indecision
pages.text: Weighing options too long can delay choices. Setting a deadline helps.

pages.title: Partnership
pages.text: Values kindness, beauty and reciprocity. Wants a relationship between equals.

pages.title: The one who unites
pages.text: Does well in teams, negotiation, design and service, where diplomacy matters.
